mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) combined with quetiapine (atypical antipsychotic) increases risk of serotonin syndrome, orthostatic hypotension, and excessive CNS depression through monoamine pathway inhibition and additive pharmacodynamic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, use lowest doses with careful monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms, blood pressure changes, and CNS effects; ensure adequate washout period when switching MAOIs.
